articles.title: AI DEMAND THREATENS A CIRCUIT BOARD SHORTAGE
articles.summary: The Global Electronics Association warns that AI server demand is straining circuit board supplies and crowding out automotive, medical, and industrial orders. Increasingly complex boards consume more materials and manufacturing capacity, with meaningful supply relief unlikely before mid-2028.

articles.title: UBUNTU TARGETS 2028 FOR ITS IMMUTABLE DESKTOP
articles.summary: Canonical is targeting Ubuntu 28.04 LTS for Core Desktop, with a tentative goal of making it the default download in 30.04. The system uses isolated snap packages and atomic updates to reduce dependency conflicts and simplify rollbacks, while traditional Ubuntu will remain available.

articles.title: AN INSIDER'S LOOK AT SAP'S AUTONOMOUS ENTERPRISE
articles.summary: SAP chief AI officer explains how the company is addressing cost control, governance, and model management for its Autonomous Enterprise concept and AI agents. SAP uses a tiered approach combining daily usage limits, default model settings, and centralized controls via tools like Joule Studio and the SAP Enterprise AI Gateway. While SAP is developing automated model routing and tighter integration with business processes, challenges remain in directly linking token consumption to financial value.

articles.title: YOUR CLOUD MONITORING MAY MISS AI FAILURES
articles.summary: An AI service can stay online while producing incorrect answers, violating policies, or running up unexpected costs. Operations teams need to monitor output quality, agent behavior, and spending, and design recovery processes that restore trustworthy behavior alongside availability.

articles.title: KEEP HUMAN & AGENT ACCESS SHORT-LIVED AND TASK-BASED
articles.summary: Standing privileges keep your security team up at night. And they should, because they expand your blast radius. They increase your risk of credential sharing, forgotten contractor access, and audit gaps. Teleport replaces standing privileges with auto-expiring, just-in-time privileges delivered at speed and scale.

articles.title: INTRODUCING AMBIENT NETWORKING FOR GKE
articles.summary: Google has announced the general availability of ambient networking for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), introducing a sidecar-less service mesh architecture into production. The system decouples networking functionality from application workloads, shifting responsibilities to shared per-node components and managed control plane services to reduce resource consumption and management overhead.

articles.title: AWS PREVIEWS CENTRALIZED INTERNET FIREWALL CONTROLS
articles.summary: AWS Network Firewall can now apply centralized filtering rules directly at VPC internet gateways without requiring routing or architectural changes. The preview includes built-in NAT and can automatically extend security policies to newly created VPCs and subnets.

articles.title: GITHUB ENTERPRISE SERVER 3.23 RELEASE CANDIDATE
articles.summary: GitHub has released the release candidate for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23, introducing new platform capabilities including improved filtering in GitHub Projects, AI-powered secret detection for air-gapped environments, and expanded malware detection across multiple package ecosystems. The update also adds a default cooldown for Dependabot version updates, optional OAuth token expiration, and cluster configuration improvements.

articles.title: AWS ADDS AN API FOR INSTANT WORKLOAD COST ESTIMATES
articles.summary: The new Pricing Calculator API estimates up to 500 usage lines per request using public or customer-specific rates, letting teams price infrastructure directly within their existing tools.

articles.title: AWS DEVOPS AGENT ADDS NEW CHAT CAPABILITIES
articles.summary: AWS DevOps Agent now executes GitHub and PagerDuty actions directly from Claude Code, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.

articles.title: GOOGLE QUANTUM AI SHOWS CONTEXTUALITY UP TO 105 QUBITS
articles.summary: Google's Willow quantum processor successfully outperformed classical limits in the Mermin-Peres magic square game with a 98.3% success rate.

articles.title: WINDOWS HOTPATCH CAUSES APPLICATION FAILURES
articles.summary: Microsoft has acknowledged application failures following November's Windows 11 hotpatch and provided a Registry workaround requiring a restart.
